newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police find weapons in neo-Nazi raids.
newsitem.headline: German police find weapons in neo-Nazi raids.

text.p: Police said on Friday they had found explosives and weapons in raids on the homes of suspected members of a neo-Nazi group and detained eight people.

The raids, which took place on Wednesday, centred on the homes of young men in Berlin and the surrounding area, police said. They suspect the men had formed a successor organisation to the banned "Viking Youth" group of right-wing extremists.

Police said they had recovered explosives, components for explosive devices and detonators, camouflage clothing and propaganda material. They did not gave any details about the weapons they had found.
Seven of the suspects were detained only temporarily while another was placed under arrest.
